Verses.Text: His divine power has bestowed on us everything that makes for life and devotion, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and power.
For no prophecy ever came through human will; but rather human beings moved by the Holy Spirit spoke under the influence of God.
The Lord does not delay his promise, as some regard delay, but he is patient with you, not wishing that any should perish but that all should come to repentance.
But grow in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and savior Jesus Christ.
